storage: Store in an airtight jar away from heat and light for up to about 3 months after opening. In Mumbai's heat and humidity, keep it in the fridge (up to about 6 months) or freezer (up to a year) to stop it going rancid. Roasted seeds go stale faster; roast only what you need.
